decision.summary: A sustained N-component elevation begins near index 587, peaks ~595–605, and declines after 609; the return phase is incomplete within allowed context [550,650], and cross-axis (E/U) responses are inconsistent with a clean temporary offset—suggesting possible superposed motion. No confirmed temporary offset interval due to ambiguous return.

intervals.observation: N shows elevated plateau from ~590 to 609 (centered ~2–3 MAD above local trend), with gradual onset starting ~587 and slow decline beginning ~610; E and U exhibit lagged, opposing fluctuations but no clear return to pre-event baseline within allowed context. Return not observed before index 650.
